answer: Registration requires burning a fee that is permanently recorded on the public ledger, so each identity carries a visible, non-recoverable cost. An attacker cannot cheaply multiply identities, because every clone must independently burn real value. Agents encountering a new identity check that burn record; an identity with no burn trail is treated as an untrusted echo and ignored. Honest agents periodically publish a beacon anchoring their burn history, letting peers verify continuity without central authority. This raises the marginal price of forgery, and a zephyr of coordinated fake.
